title: Exact money amount (USD)
description: A decimal string denominated in the unit the field name states. Signedness is the field's contract, not a type: ledger.Entry.Amount is signed (positive = credit, negative = debit) and refuses exactly zero; treasury.Movement.Amount is a strictly POSITIVE magnitude; portfolio.Holding.ValueUSD is non-negative and uses null for unknown, never '0'. There are NO integer minor-unit (cents) money fields in the repo except the provider's own ChainRank cents (research/chainrank-listing.json), which this contract keeps as integers because that is what the upstream ships.
